notes.title: Human Fast Food
notes.notes:
Hi guys
It's not every day that a solo developer puts up a Steam page, is it? The only moment more exciting than that is launch day, but let's not rush things.

if you're into cooking games, take a look at my newest development: Human Fast Food, where monsters get served with human meat.

You can wishlist the game here:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3281090/Human_Fast_Food/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3281090/Human_Fast_Food/[/url]

Also, feel free to join the playtest list, I'll be talking more about it in the coming weeks.
